name: Inicio
description: Multi-tenant survey and data-collection platform: a real expression engine, offline-first collection that never loses an answer, and analysis-ready exports. Invitation-only, with tenant isolation enforced by PostgreSQL row-level security.

paragraphs: Real logic. Offline collection. Analysis-ready data.

A multi-tenant platform for building forms with genuine skipping and validation logic, circulating them to the people who actually have the answers, collecting responses anywhere — including where there is no signal — and exporting data that is ready for analysis rather than merely downloaded.
Accounts are invitation only. Every organisation sees its own data and nothing else, and that boundary is enforced by PostgreSQL, not by the application.

A device-generated UUID is the response id. A start that is retried after a dropped connection resumes the same response; a retried submit answers 409 alreadysubmitted, which the client reads as success rather than loss.

Valkey (cache/queue), MinIO (S3-compatible object storage) and ClamAV (upload scanning) are in the self-hosted compose profile, and the attachment path is the one that uses them: point AWSENDPOINTURLS3 at MinIO and CLAMDHOST at ClamAV and uploads, limits and the scan run exactly as they do in production, where the store is a managed one.

With Resend, MAILFROM must be an address on a verified domain in that account: an unverified one is rejected outright (This API key is not authorized to send emails from …), and the shared onboarding@resend.dev sender is accepted but only reaches the account's own address.
